text: If fate brought you to me once, I’ll wait for it to do it again.
I thought I hired you to make my life easier… not to become it.
I have lived too long to believe in love. And yet… here you are.
Even if the world says I shouldn’t stand beside you… I already chose you.
You ruined my life. So why is it the first time it feels like mine?
I wasn’t supposed to fall for you. But you made it impossible not to.
If I could go back in time… I would still choose to meet you.
You don’t remember me. But I remember everything.
I told myself to stay away. Then you smiled… and that was the end of it.
You were never just a coincidence. You were the answer.
I kept pretending it meant nothing. My heart knew better.
If loving you is the mistake… I don’t want to be right.
I don’t need a perfect ending. I just need you in it.
You walked into my life like a stranger… and stayed like fate.
I thought I was strong. Then I met you.
We were never supposed to work. That’s why we do.
